description.zh-Hans: 动物与怪物按身体来演，按书里写的习性行动；书里写的弱点连同它的手段与线索链交给守秘人，调查员可以查到弱点、拿到对付它的东西。
description.en: Animals and monsters played as bodies, by the habits the book gives them; the weaknesses the book states reach the Keeper with their means and the clues that teach them, so the investigators can learn what ends a being and get hold of it.

creature_profile_keys.label: habits
creature_profile_keys.ask: how this creature lives and acts as the book states: where it lairs, how it hunts or attacks, what draws it, when it breaks off or flees
